notes: Watchdog freeze fix: exhaustion after two silent restarts is never terminal - the engine retries every 60s while listening is wanted, recovers on the next callback, and resets on unlock; a stranded watchdog suspension is force-resumed after 90s. No picker/gate/silence/provider change - accuracy diagnostics (alternatives + voice-timing lines) verified on every final. Freeze and accuracy are phone-unproven - the diagnostic log decides. No new STT engine, no new permissions, no internal-audio capture.
